package.name: drishti_traversability
package.description:
Camera-derived terrain cost. Fuses elevation geometry (slope, roughness, height variance, step) with semantic class and observation uncertainty into a single traversability field, and projects it into a Nav2 costmap layer.
This is the component specific to this problem: Nav2, RTAB-Map and the elevation mapper are reused, but turning vision into terrain judgement a planner will respect is the actual work. SPEC.md section 6.
